title: The Vanishing Hours -- Episode 2: The Somerton Man
description:
Real, sourced cases of people who vanished without explanation -- calmly told, perfect for falling asleep to. Episode 2: in 1948, a well-dressed man was found dead on an Australian beach with no name, no wallet, and a hidden note reading 'it is finished.' It took 74 years to learn who he was. Nobody has ever learned how he died.

Every case in this series is real and sourced -- see the sources list.
